states.loading: Announce loading only while the current identity/company request is pending.
states.empty: An unpublished draft may be paused/retired; Resume requires a published revision.
states.partial: Material Run now, independently verified business outcomes and complete workflow authoring remain open. Current waiting/recovering runs differ from failed historical runs; source failure suppresses the overview.
states.stale: A stale expected status, timestamp or revision pointer is refused. During private read rechecks all controls and receipts are hidden.
states.validation_error: Strict action/request/status/timestamp/revision/finish-existing schema; canonical pre-effect conflicts allow a fresh reviewed request.
states.system_error: Transport, authorization and malformed/foreign receipt failures remain unconfirmed. Preserve the original tuple and offer exact retry without new request identity.
states.permission_denied: Current authority/source/feature loss suppresses controls and refuses effects/replay. Navigation and a previous receipt confer no grant.
states.recovering: Retry the original request; repeat current native admission before returning its stored receipt. Failed/timed-out tools and unfinished native children block retirement until reconciled.
states.success: Only a bound canonical receipt confirms that original change; it does not establish current running status or independently verified work.

navigation.back: Return to existing native workflow list.

navigation.resume: Re-read current company/principal/native revision and grants. Flag rollback restores the existing graph editor; /advanced preserves a direct graph route.

accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.
